verdict.rationale: PagerDuty's REST API and Events API docs explicitly cover most administrative and operational actions available in the UI—user/team management, escalation policies, workflows, incident creation/resolution, on-call schedules—and the official MCP server further exposes account data/actions to AI clients (pagerduty-docs-32,39,44,51,54,34). However, there is no explicit vendor claim of full UI/API parity, and community feedback notes real API friction (confusing v1/v2 Events API key handling, some settings requiring manual support intervention rather than API/UI access) (pagerduty-comm-6, pagerduty-comm-4), suggesting some UI-only workflows still exist. missing for 10: an explicit statement of complete UI-to-API feature parity, and confirmation that all UI-configurable settings (e.g., OIDC/SSO nuances) are also API-configurable.
